en: A vintage sepia postcard showing an elevated panoramic view of a small European town with two‑ and three‑storey buildings around an open square. The roofs are mostly metal, and the streets appear unpaved. In the foreground is a central square with a few simple kiosks or small structures. Beyond the town, rolling countryside and fields stretch into the distance. The word "Wenden." is printed in large letters at the bottom, and along the left edge is the credit "Phot. u. Lichtdr v. L. BOREWITZ WENDEN."
